notes: The portable scenario advances a not-yet-constrained federate to logical time 5 while a regulator establishes GALT=5, then requests Enable Time Constrained and verifies that no callback occurs at equality. After the regulator advances so GALT=6, the requester receives exactly one timeConstrainedEnabled callback reporting its unchanged logical time 5. The primary and contract twin pass the installed-package MinGW CTest gate under HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE (4/4) against the rebuilt current-source package. An earlier failure came from a stale installed archive, not the current RTI source. The adapter supplies the provider, FOM, logical-time implementation, endpoint, and callback model. Evidence is provider-specific experimental evidence, not a conformance claim.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::enableTimeRegulation, timeAdvanceRequest, enableTimeConstrained, disableTimeConstrained, disableTimeRegulation; FederateAmbassador::timeRegulationEnabled, timeAdvanceGrant, timeConstrainedEnabled
